fieldNotes.truckGate: Open industrial driveways off N. 25th Ave / Rose St lead directly into the complex; no barrier arm, sliding gate or pinch-point checkpoint visible at the property line on either entrance. Classified false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure at any entrance — confirmed in 2025-03 Street View along 25th Ave; entrances are open paved drives flanked by parking.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~4 connected/adjacent industrial buildings (dark-roof main plant, lighter converting buildings, brick dock building on Rose St) occupying the block between N. 25th Ave and the rail corridor.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur runs through the property between the building clusters on the east side — visible as a curving track corridor in z18/z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Sand/gravel fenced trailer lot on the east side holds ~14 trailers without tractors; capacity ~25-30.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on multiple building faces (Rose St brick building south face plus interior banks) — shipping and receiving run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban block — residential directly across N. 25th Ave; a truck queue at the open driveway would have minimal stacking room before reaching the public street.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~24 doors across the complex; counting is imprecise because docks face internal drives and several are recessed.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Interior paved drives and yard provide holding room inside the property before docks.
